segments.name: Audio and video technology
segments.description: Licenses audio and video technologies and patents to device manufacturers and sells cinema hardware and services to movie exhibitors and content creators.
segments.evidence: We operate as a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Device manufacturers and cinema exhibitors pay royalties, fees and hardware prices to license Dolby technology, brand and patents and to buy cinema products and services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate most of our revenue by licensing technology, our brand, and patents to device manufacturers, and selling cinema hardware and services to movie exhibitors.
